description: Type createServer's retryable quota and placement failures. The OpenAPI document only declares 4xx/5xx wildcards, so these currently land as Forbidden (403 resource_limit_exceeded, message contains 'server limit') and PreconditionFailed (412 resource_unavailable, message contains 'placement'). Dedicated tags let callers retry without matching on message text.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The project has no remaining Server quota (Hetzner `resource_limit_exceeded`, HTTP 403). Often a race after a delete — retry.
The Server could not be placed (Hetzner `resource_unavailable` / `placement_error`, HTTP 412). Spread groups and location capacity recover — retry.
